definitions.explanation: Having no relation or connection to something. Used to describe things, people, or matters that are not involved or connected.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無関係|むかんけい}です。
examples.english: I am unrelated to that incident.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無関係|むかんけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The match will be held regardless of the weather.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}たち→私たち：28351_watashitachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{無関係|むかんけい}⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、{一人|ひとり}ひとり⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: This issue is not unrelated to our daily lives, and each person should think about it.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無関係|むかんけい}だ: to have nothing to do with ~
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無関係|むかんけい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: regardless of ~ (close to 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧)
- {無関係|むかんけい}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: an uninvolved person, a bystander
- {無関係|むかんけい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: not unrelated; a common way to stress that something does matter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: (it) doesn't matter, it's none of my business; the everyday spoken form
- ⟦{無縁|むえん}→無縁：13477_muen⟧: having no connection with; often about a person and a way of life (⟦{贅沢|ぜいたく}→贅沢：03309_zeitaku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{無縁|むえん}→無縁：13477_muen⟧だ)
